import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,base64
p=Path.cwd();a=p.parent/'expanded-corpus-r380/sources'
for source,page,name in [(a/'350365.pdf',6,'entropoid-definition'),(a/'350365.pdf',18,'entropoid-conjecture'),(a/'345451.pdf',2,'genius-conjecture')]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-singlefile','-scale-to','1500','-png',str(source)],capture_output=True,timeout=25)
 assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),name+'.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode(),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert w.returncode==0
 print(name,page,len(r.stdout))
